consumption_checkpoint: Actual original encoder bytes plus frozen/observed native-token identity and counts. Compare newly accepted and changed accepted offers, tokens/alphabets/encoder cost if warranted. No full gate allocation before useful quality and original total-time evidence.
stop_for_small_effect: If native savings remain on the order of A6/A7/A5 small components, retain that result but do not extend depth or enumerate nearby thresholds. Root decides whether total timing can materially change the larger target decision.
